audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2 and 5 disagreed with packet.levelChart (Skill/Poppy/Poppy/Skill/Skill/Skill/Yorick) and with the whys, which call levels 2-3 Poppy's strongest early window and first item even.
audit.why: The chart gave Yorick the exact levels the text calls Poppy's punish window.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2 and 5 flipped as matched full+content pairs with the two early ratings raised.

audit.why: Levels 2-3 for Poppy, level 6 as peel not burst, and 2+ items for Yorick match the kit: Eulogy of the Isles is a 160/130/100s summon that only compounds with items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly calls the cage his E — 'E mist-cage', 'E mist-ring', 'his E cage', and an 'inner ring' that detonates. The cage is Dark Procession (W), a destructible wall that blocks movement, on 20/18/16/14/12s. Mourning Mist (E) is a thrown globule that reduces armour, slows, and marks you so his summons speed toward you; it does not cage and nothing about it detonates.
audit.why: A player told to walk out before 'the inner ring detonates' is being taught a mechanic that does not exist, and is tracking the wrong cooldown by 8 seconds.
audit.corrected: Cage attributed to Dark Procession with its real cooldown; Mourning Mist described as the armour-shred mark that accelerates ghouls; Last Rites given as the auto-reset heal tell.

audit.why: Dark Procession's 20s at rank 1 is the window worth waiting for; Last Rites at 6s is not.
audit.corrected: Numbers now attached to the cage and to the first-item why.

edits.before: Your real window is levels 2-3. Once you have Q and E, look to E him into the lane wall for the stun and follow with Hammer Shock (Q) — your max-HP damage chunks him hard before Maiden exists. Bait out his E mist-ring; if he cages you, walk OUT of it before the inner ring detonates rather than fighting inside it. Do not let ghouls stack on you while you trade — clear them with Q so they stop adding free damage.
edits.after: Your real window is levels 2-3. Once you have Q and E, look to E him into the lane wall for the stun and follow with Hammer Shock (Q) — your max-HP damage chunks him hard before Maiden exists. Respect Dark Procession (W): the cage is a destructible wall on 20 seconds, so walk out of it or break it instead of trading inside. Do not let ghouls stack on you while you trade — clear them with Q so they stop adding free damage.

edits.before: This is his game. By 2+ items full Maiden plus ghouls plus the E mist-cage zone you completely off the wave, and his sustained swarm out-damages your flat kit in any extended side-lane fight — never duel him inside his mist. Your value shifts to teamfights: use W to body-block his Maiden and ghoul path, E and R to peel and lock targets, and let your team punish him while he's split. Don't chase a 1v1 you can't win after items.
edits.after: This is his game. notes: The content layer had Yorick's W and E swapped throughout: it called the cage his E and described an 'inner ring' detonating, which is not a Yorick mechanic at all. Dark Procession (W, 20/18/16/14/12s) is the destructible movement-blocking wall; Mourning Mist (E, 12/11/10/9/8s) is the armour-shredding slow that marks a target so his summons accelerate toward it. Chart rows 1, 2 and 5 also disagreed with packet.levelChart and their own whys.
